description: Post a marketplace BUY request (verified account, marketplace:write): wallet_id, frontier, resource_type, unit_type, units_needed, max_price_per_unit and options. Escrow is debited on match. A physical trade must carry `physical_claim` (the site and dates).

kind.description: physical_change: something changed at the site between t0 and t1 · physical_state: the site shows something …

site_entity_type.description: the GreenlandAI entity at the site, if any

t0.description: YYYY-MM-DD; required for physical_change, before t1, on or after 1984-03-16

max_price_per_unit.description: the most a background re-match may pay a unit: 1 .. the request's own max_price_per_unit (default: that …

window_seconds.description: how long the consent lasts, 300-86400 s (default 86400)

contract_escrow.description: opt in to the on-chain escrow contract lane (a flat contract fee added to your lock).

frontier.description: the marketplace frontier to buy in

idempotency_key.description: your own opaque key: the same key and body is one request, never two

max_price_per_unit.description: the most you pay per unit, in joules, a whole number > 0

physical_claim.description: REQUIRED for resource_type scene_stack, change_report, site_reconstruction or satellite_imagery (refused …

priority.description: matching priority, per the RAREEAI docs

privacy_mode.description: the request's privacy mode, per the RAREEAI docs

provider_id.description: the listing to buy from: a provider id from market_listings (kind providers).

rematch.description: MACHINE speed only: allow automatic re-matching if a match on this request ends without delivery, within …

requirements.description: extra requirements for providers, as a JSON object

speed.description: the delivery speed class you want, per the RAREEAI docs

ttl_seconds.description: seconds until the request expires unmatched

unit_type.description: the unit you buy in (the provider's unit_type)

units_needed.description: how many units, a whole number > 0

wallet_id.description: your wallet UUID: it pays the escrow when the request matches

body.description: The buy request; each field is described in its schema.

name: market_request
